mentions.name: Forvard
mentions.description: Forvard is a local-first accomplishment tracker for career tracking that keeps all data stored on the user's device. It includes built-in smartness to summarize accomplishments locally, without sending data over the network, and is built with Tauri and Svelte.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built https://forvard.org/ with Tauri + Svelte; Forvard is a accomplishment tracker where your data lives locally (think of Obsidian but for career tracking), it has a bit of smartness to summarize your accomplishments (without sending your data over the network).
